summary: The change adds `halo app delete`, which is resumable. It first marks the record as `deleting` and revokes runtime credentials. It then removes the VM, the owner-workspace reference, the backup, and any leftover source and data, and finally drops the app rows. The new tests resolve all five round-1 findings: durable refusals for demos, unfinished publications, and unsupported providers; a temp `beginDeletion` race test; a temp CLI test; a temp Electron E2E for the deleting-state dialog; and temp permission-failure cleanup tests. All runs pass, the coverage gate passes, and no defects remain.
